Section previews are schematic and may differ from the actual layout/spacing (beam/column/brace use the center section, wall uses the plan section).

beam.modeChangeConfirm: The sector(s) hidden by this mode currently have different values — switching will overwrite them to match what's shown. Continue?
beam.memberPreviewHint: Pick one element sharing this section to check its actual saved values. Saving still applies the values shown here to every element in the section.
beam.checkHint: Computes phiMn/phiVn instantly from the diagram dimensions (B/H) and cover (DT/DB) above. This is a singly-reinforced approximation (compression steel ignored); use the button below to pull Mu/Vu from your Gen NX design results, or enter them manually.
beam.checkUnsupported: This design code isn't supported yet (only KDS 41 20:2022 and TWN-USD112, GB/T50010-10)
beam.fetchHint: Only works for a member whose design check (BC-ANAL) has already been run in Gen NX. You can still edit the values after loading.
beam.fetchEmpty: This member hasn't been checked in Gen NX yet (BC-ANAL not run).
board.unsupportedCode: The current design code does not support instant checking (KDS 41 20:2022 · TWN-USD112 · GB/T50010-10 only) — editing still works, verdicts are hidden.
board.gbMaterialHint: GB code: enter the concrete grade for fck (C30 → 30) and the rebar characteristic yield strength for fy·fyt (HRB400 → 400) — the same values Gen NX shows. They are converted to GB design strengths (fc·fy) for the check.
board.gbDetailPartial: fck/fy/fyt are outside the GB material tables, so the strength-based rules (minimum steel ratio, stirrup ratio) were not checked — only spacing and diameters.
board.pingfaNote: Grade letters from fy/fyt: A=HPB300, B=HRB335, C=HRB400, D=HRB500. Stirrups: end (dense) / mid (non-dense) spacing (legs). Longitudinal: top through bars;bottom bars.
board.pingfaNone: Set fy and fyt to a GB rebar grade (300 / 335 / 400 / 500) to show 平法 notation.
board.pingfaWaitMember: The 平法 grade letters come from the bar strength (fy) in Gen NX's results table — shown after a re-check.
board.pingfaNoteColumn: Grade letters from Gen NX's fy/fys: A=HPB300, B=HRB335, C=HRB400, D=HRB500. Ties: dense zone / non-dense zone spacing. With a corner bar the bars split into 角筋 + 中部筋 (REBC has no per-side split, so the middle bars are one total).
board.pingfaNoteWall: 墙身 notation: Q(curtains) thickness, horizontal / vertical distribution bars. Grade letters from Gen NX's fy/fys; tie bars (拉筋) aren't in REBW, so they're not shown.
board.crackNoCombo: This model has no SERVICE design combination. Add the quasi-permanent combination (e.g. 1.0D + 0.5L) as SERVICE in Gen NX's concrete design combinations, then run the analysis.
board.crackNoMoment: No service moment came back for that combination — check that the analysis has been run.
board.crackNote: For reference only. Mq is Gen NX's member force for the chosen combination (worst across the section's elements per location); bars and cover come from the board. Flexural αcr = 1.9, ribbed bars ν = 1.0, Es = 2.0×10⁵ MPa.
board.gbDetailOk: Meets the GB detailing rules checked here.
board.gbDetailNote: For reference only — not counted in OK/NG (Gen NX's GB check governs). Non-seismic rules only; pick a seismic grade in the design-code panel to add the seismic rules.
board.gbDetail.sMax: Stirrup spacing {actual} mm > max {limit} mm (GB 50010 Table 9.2.9)
board.gbDetail.barDiaTop: Top bar Ø{actual} < min Ø{limit} mm (GB 50010 9.2.1)
board.gbDetail.barDiaBot: Bottom bar Ø{actual} < min Ø{limit} mm (GB 50010 9.2.1)
board.gbDetailNoteSeis: For reference only — not counted in OK/NG (Gen NX's GB check governs). Includes the frame-beam rules for seismic {grade} (GB 55008 4.4.8, GB 50011 6.3.3–6.3.4).
board.gbDetail.seisRhoMinTop: End top ρ {actual}% < min {limit}% (GB 55008 Table 4.4.8-1, support)
board.gbDetail.seisRhoMinBot: Mid-span bottom ρ {actual}% < min {limit}% (GB 55008 Table 4.4.8-1, span)
board.gbDetail.seisDenseS: End dense-zone stirrup spacing {actual} mm > max {limit} mm (GB 55008 Table 4.4.8-2)
board.gbDetail.seisDenseDia: End dense-zone stirrup Ø{actual} < min Ø{limit} mm (GB 55008 Table 4.4.8-2)
board.gbDetail.seisThroughTop: Top full-length bars {actual} mm² < required {limit} mm² (≥2 bars, min Ø, ¼ of ends; GB 50011 6.3.4-1)
board.gbDetail.seisThroughBot: Bottom full-length bars {actual} mm² < required {limit} mm² (≥2 bars, min Ø, ¼ of ends; GB 50011 6.3.4-1)
board.seisWaitColumn: Axial ratio, min ρ and volumetric tie ratio use the axial force and materials from Gen NX's results table — save, then re-check to see them.
board.seisWaitWall: Wall axial ratio and distribution ρ use Gen NX's results table — save, then re-check to see them.
board.seisOk: Meets every GB seismic detailing rule checked here.
board.seisNoteColumn: For reference only — not counted in OK/NG. The axial force is Gen NX's governing P-M combination, which may not be the maximum. Corner columns and column bases are detected from the model geometry (editable above); λ = Hn/(2h0) uses the clear height (storey height minus the deepest beam) and the longer side. The joint core assumes the column end ties continue through it.
board.seisNoteWall: For reference only — not counted in OK/NG. The axial ratio uses the design-combination force — more conservative than the gravity representative load of GB 50011 6.4.2 — at the worst storey. Boundary elements: hidden columns (暗柱) of straight walls only, grade 1 taken at intensity 7/8, end-bar count (NUM) is per end (confirmed in Gen NX's report).
board.seis.colDenseS: Dense-zone tie spacing {actual} mm > max {limit} mm (GB 55008 Table 4.4.9-2)
board.seis.colDenseDia: Dense-zone tie Ø{actual} < min Ø{limit} mm (GB 55008 Table 4.4.9-2)
board.seis.colRhoV: Dense-zone volumetric tie ratio {actual}% < required {limit}% (λv·fc/fyv, GB 50011 6.3.9)
board.seis.colCenS: Non-dense-zone tie spacing {actual} mm > max {limit} mm (GB 50011 6.3.9-4)
board.sitNoGeo: Model geometry not read yet — checking with the general-column rules.
board.beConstruct: Boundary element: constructional (构造边缘构件) — Ac = {ac} mm²
board.beConstrain: Boundary element: confined (约束边缘构件) required — lc = {lc} mm, Ac = {ac} mm²
board.seis.colRhoMinCorner: Corner column total ρ {actual}% < min {limit}% (GB 55008 Table 4.4.9-1, 角柱)
board.seis.colDenseSBase: Column-base dense-zone tie spacing {actual} mm > max {limit} mm (GB 55008 Table 4.4.9-2)
board.seis.colFullDenseShort: Shear-span ratio λ ≤ 2: full-height dense ties — mid spacing {actual} mm > {limit} mm (GB 55008 4.4.9-2)
board.seis.colFullDenseCorner: Grade 1/2 corner columns are densified full height — mid spacing {actual} mm > {limit} mm (GB 50011 6.3.9-1)
board.seis.jointRhoV: Joint-core volumetric tie ratio {actual}% < required {limit}% (end ties assumed continuous, GB 50011 6.3.10)
board.seis.beNoEnd: No end bars — the boundary element needs ≥ {limit} mm² (GB 50011 6.4.5)
board.seis.beDia: Boundary-element bar Ø{actual} < min Ø{limit} mm (GB 50011 6.4.5)
board.seis.beTieDia: Boundary-element tie Ø{actual} < min Ø{limit} mm (GB 50011 Table 6.4.5-2)
board.seis.beTieS: Boundary-element tie spacing {actual} mm > max {limit} mm (GB 50011 6.4.5)
board.seis.beNoTie: No boundary-element ties (BE horizontal bars) — needed at ≤ {limit} mm (GB 50011 6.4.5)
board.seis.beRhoV: Confined boundary volumetric tie ratio {actual}% < required {limit}% (λv·fc/fyv, GB 50011 Table 6.4.5-3)
board.seis.beLen: Boundary-element length {actual} mm < lc {limit} mm (GB 50011 Table 6.4.5-3)
board.detailNote: For reference only — not counted in OK/NG (Gen NX's check governs).
board.detailOk: Meets the KDS detailing rules checked here.
board.detail.sMax: Stirrup spacing {actual} mm > max {limit} mm (≤ d/2 and 600 mm, KDS 14 20 22 4.3.2)
board.detail.sMaxHalved: Stirrup spacing {actual} mm > max {limit} mm (halved because Vs > √fck/3·bw·d, KDS 14 20 22 4.3.2(3))
board.detail.avMin: Stirrup area {actual} mm² < Av,min {limit} mm² (KDS 14 20 22 Eq. 4.3-1)

guide.title: User Guide
guide.intro: This tool connects directly to the MIDAS Gen NX Open API to edit rebar. If this is your first time, follow the steps below.
guide.step1: Open Gen NX → get a MAPI Key from the top menu's API Settings and copy it.
guide.step2: Click the "API Settings" button in the top-right, paste the MAPI Key, choose the product (Gen NX/Civil NX), then verify the connection and save.
guide.step3: Select the design code and rebar material standard at the top (standards verified against real Gen NX data are marked with a badge).
guide.step4: Each Beam/Column/Wall/Brace tab is a section board (one row per section) with search, sort and a detail editor. Pick a section, edit the rebar (use the dropdown for a quick pick of sizes) — beam sections show a live OK/NG preview as you type. Saving applies the change directly to your Gen NX model, once per section.
guide.step7: To get an OK/NG from Gen NX's own design check (Beam/Column/Wall/Brace, KDS 41 20:2022 and GB/T50010-10 models): after saving rebar, click "Run analysis" once, then "Re-check" — either the whole model or just this section/wall. The verdict badge reads "Gen NX" when it comes from Gen NX, or "Estimate" for the in-browser formula (beams only).
guide.step5: Use the Project Review tab for a full model summary (elements/sections/materials/load combinations/boundary conditions) and a 3D geometry view. The "Load all" button on the tab bar loads every tab — beam/column/wall/brace plus the model info and 3D — in one click.
guide.step6: Beam board's in-browser formula: with fck/fy/fyt in the board toolbar (and Mu/Vu from "Load results for all sections"), each section gets an instant "Estimate" verdict — used before a Gen NX check exists and while a row has unsaved edits (KDS 41 20:2022, TWN-USD112, GB/T50010-10 only; compression steel ignored). On KDS models the board also flags detailing rules (stirrup spacing, minimum shear steel, 1.2Mcr) with a ⚠ — for reference, not counted in OK/NG.
guide.step8: "Export report" on each board writes Gen NX's own design-check report (Graphic / Detail / Summary, by member or by section) to a folder on the PC running Gen NX. Run the Gen NX design check first, and use a folder that already exists.
designCode.hint: The rebar sizes offered in the BEAM/COLUMN/WALL/BRACE input dropdowns follow the design code picked here.
designCode.gbSystem.dual: Frame-wall / frame-core (框架-抗震墙/核心筒)
designCode.gbSystem.frameSupported: Partial frame-supported wall (部分框支抗震墙)
designCode.gbSeismicHint: The Gen NX API has no GB seismic grade, so pick it here. The beam/column/wall boards then show GB 55008 §4.4 / GB 50011 §6.3–6.4 seismic detailing warnings and the axial ratio (advisory).
designCode.overrideHint: Material standard differs from this design code's default (e.g. Eurocode design with Korean rebar).
guide.codeConfirmWarning: This design code's material mapping has regional variation — please double-check for your actual project.
guide.release.v1_10_2.item1: The wall section diagram now draws end bars as laid out in Gen NX (count per end, in rows of two).
guide.release.v1_10_2.item2: The wall end-bar count field now reads 'Count (each end)' so it isn't entered as a two-end total.
guide.release.v1_10_2.item3: Storey strength table: flags the values as outdated after a rebar save or analysis run, and the rebar note now shows on GB models only.
guide.release.v1_10_2.item4: Members typed as braces in Gen NX no longer show up as beam sections on the beam board.
guide.release.v1_10_2.item5: Bar diameters are now found even when the model's bar labels differ from the design code's material DB (e.g. d10 on a KDS model), so detailing checks and estimates no longer read 0 mm².
guide.release.v1_10_1.item1: Notes updated from live checks: the wall end-bar count is confirmed per end, and the storey shear strength reflects the rebar — save it and run the analysis to refresh.
guide.release.v1_10_0.item1: GB column seismic checks now detect corner columns, column bases (柱根) and the shear-span ratio λ from the model geometry and apply their rules (corner ρmin, full-height dense ties, base spacing, λ ≤ 2 axial limit and tie ratio). You can override the detection in the drawer.
guide.release.v1_10_0.item2: GB columns: the joint core's volumetric tie ratio is checked (GB 50011 6.3.10).
guide.release.v1_10_0.item3: GB walls: the bottom-storey axial ratio decides constructional vs confined boundary elements, and the end bars, ties and boundary length are checked (GB 50011 6.4.5).
guide.release.v1_10_0.item4: The project tab adds the storey shear strength ratio (楼层受剪承载力比): Gen NX's storey shear strength against the storey above, judged for GB models at 80 %/65 % (class A) and 75 % (class B).
guide.release.v1_9_0.item1: GB models: the beam drawer adds a crack-width check (GB 50010 7.1.2). Pick Gen NX's SERVICE (quasi-permanent) combination to compare the max crack width at I / mid / J with the limit (0.2/0.3/0.4 mm).
guide.release.v1_9_0.item2: GB models: the column and wall boards now show 平法 notation too (columns 12C20 C10@100/200, walls Q(2排) 200 with distribution bars), after a re-check.
guide.release.v1_9_0.item3: When a design check fails because the model has no load combinations, the board now explains how to generate them in Gen NX.
guide.release.v1_9_0.item4: Fixed a false wall warning when Gen NX reports the horizontal distribution ratio as 0, and the garbled axial-ratio column header.
guide.release.v1_8_0.item1: GB models: pick a seismic grade (1–4) and structure type in the design-code panel to add GB 55008 / GB 50011 seismic rules to the beam detailing check (end dense zone, support ρmin, x/h0, full-length bars…).
guide.release.v1_8_0.item2: GB models: the column and wall boards gain an axial-ratio column (μN / limit) and seismic detailing warnings (min ρ, dense-zone ties, volumetric tie ratio, wall distribution bars), shown after a Gen NX re-check.
guide.release.v1_8_0.item3: Fixed the tab icon (favicon) showing as a globe in some browsers.
guide.release.v1_7_0.item1: GB models: the beam board shows 平法 (22G101-1) notation — a 平法 column in the table, and centralized (集中标注) / in-situ (原位标注) notation in the detail drawer, with A/B/C/D grade letters from fy/fyt
guide.release.v1_7_0.item2: GB models: beam detailing warnings — minimum steel ratio (GB 55008 Table 4.4.6), stirrup spacing (GB 50010 Table 9.2.9), stirrup ratio 0.24ft/fyv, and minimum bar/stirrup diameters; for reference, not counted in OK/NG
guide.release.v1_7_0.item3: KDS and GB minimum-flexural-steel warnings now look only at the tension side (top bars at the supports, bottom bars at mid-span), so through/架立 bars no longer raise false warnings
guide.release.v1_6_6.item1: Fixed: the first rebar save on a column/brace section or wall that had no rebar yet failed with Gen NX's "Wrong Field" / "Unknown Error" — new rows now default to 2 main-bar rows and 40 mm wall covers (all design codes)
guide.release.v1_6_6.item2: Column/brace main-bar rows below 2 and walls without covers are now caught before saving, with a clear message instead of Gen NX's opaque error
guide.release.v1_6_5.item1: New browser-tab icon: an RC beam section (stirrup and main bars) instead of the default globe
guide.release.v1_6_5.item2: Side drawers now open and close at the same quick 0.3 s pace as the story app
guide.release.v1_6_4.item1: Fixed: side drawers popped open instantly on PCs with Windows "Animation effects" turned off — they now always slide, with a soft blur behind
guide.release.v1_6_3.item1: Side drawers no longer snap out when opening — they now start gently and glide in
guide.release.v1_6_2.item1: Side drawers (guide, settings, feedback, report) now open and close over 0.8 s for a calmer motion
guide.release.v1_6_1.item1: The footer now shows the app version — click it to open these release notes
guide.release.v1_6_1.item2: Release notes are now kept per version: every version bump ships with its notes
guide.release.v1_6_1.item3: User guide refreshed: new "Export report" step, updated beam "Estimate" verdict and KDS detailing warnings, GB models in the Gen NX check step

guide.release.d261012.item6: Side drawers open and close more smoothly, and Esc closes them

report.title: Export Gen NX report
report.intro: Exports Gen NX's own design-check report (same format as its Preview Window). Run the design check in Gen NX first — the file is saved on the PC running Gen NX.
report.scopeSelectedNone: Selected (pick a row on the board first)
report.modeHint.Graphic: One report sheet per member as an image (.jpg, plus .emf and a large .bmp).
report.modeHint.Detail: Full calculation text with every check step (.txt).
report.modeHint.PMCurve: The wall's P-M interaction diagram as an image.
report.dirLabel: Save folder (on the Gen NX PC)
report.dirHint: The folder must already exist — if it doesn't, Gen NX reports success but writes nothing.
report.okMsg: Saved by Gen NX: {path} (Graphic and multi-member exports add an index/member prefix or extension).
report.err.badPath: Enter an absolute Windows folder, e.g. C:/MIDAS/Report/
report.err.noTargets: Nothing to export — load the board first.
report.err.badMode: That format isn't available for this target type.
report.err.generic: Gen NX couldn't export the report. Check that the design check has been run in Gen NX.
